'''Card types''' in ''Star Wars'' CCG are shown by the icon in the upper left-hand corner of each card. Sites, systems and sectors have no upper-left icon and share the card type "location".<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref> The Rulebook 2.0 icon guide lists the card types of the printed game.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref>

Locations lay out on the table as a game board. Characters, vehicles and starships are the main game pieces and move from location to location. Weapons, devices and effects give them extra capabilities, and Interrupts are played at various times and then discarded.<ref name="rb20" />
